summary: Ghost exports with type page land as Pages; legacy article URLs redirect to /pages/{slug}.
detailed_changes: Ghost content import routes type:page rows into the Page model instead of posts.
Added ghost:backfill-pages to convert previously misclassified posts and create redirects.
Published Ghost pages keep stable public URLs via /articles/{slug} → /pages/{slug} redirects.
affected_areas: Page or route: /pages/{slug}, /articles/{slug} redirects, ghost import commands
User groups affected: staff running Ghost imports; public readers of migrated pages
Public impact: Ghost pages resolve under /pages and old article URLs redirect
Internal impact: idempotent backfill command for existing beta imports
